svg.title: Жим ногами широкой постановкой — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. A true 45-degree sled leg press on diagonal guide rails. The athlete lies back with hips on the low seat and both hands holding stationary side handles. BOTH feet on the same broad footplate, visibly near opposite lateral edges, distinctly wider than shoulders, toes slightly out, whole soles contacting the footplate. Left: sled near athlete, both knees bent toward torso. Right: sled moved up diagonal rails, both legs almost straight with slight knee flexion. Same machine and wide foot placement in both frames. Three-quarter side view making both soles and the full footplate readable. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
